CREATE TABLE "public"."security_access_requests" (
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "userId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "sessionId" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'PENDING' NOT NULL,
  "requestedAt" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "decidedAt" timestamptz(3),
  "decidedById" uuid,
  CONSTRAINT "security_access_requests_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "security_access_requests_sessionId_key" UNIQUE ("sessionId"),
  CONSTRAINT "security_access_requests_userId_fkey" FOREIGN KEY ("userId") REFERENCES "users" ("id") ON DELETE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT "security_access_requests_decidedById_fkey" FOREIGN KEY ("decidedById") REFERENCES "users" ("id") ON DELETE SET NULL
)
